title: BattleFrame: Full Thrust
description: Full Thrust ruleset for the BattleFrame system. An implementation of the Full Thrust starship-combat game by Jon Tuffley / Ground Zero Games (gzg.com). This module implements the game mechanics only; it ships no rulebook text, stat blocks, faction ship lists, or artwork. Bring your own ship designs. Free and non-commercial; it must not be sold.
